value.rationale: The exact all-size/all-power classification addresses the natural discrete-time Markov-smoothing stability of graph edge variation. It yields a structurally nontrivial parity effect, explicit binary extremizers, a finite odd-time extinction boundary at \(k\log k\), and a sharp nonzero rescaled transition profile, differentiating graph BV stability from standard Hilbert and Lipschitz contraction.
